QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Kamaitachi's Plan
QuestInfo.0: Kamaitachi has an idea on how to lure the hermit out. Hear what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Kamaitachi suggests you tempt the hermit with a tasty snack. Go to Bronze at the Mushroom Shrine and buy 2 Dango.
QuestInfo.2: You should try Kamaitachi's plan to lure Kurama out.
